# Code of Conduct

Participation in this repository should remain professional, constructive, and
focused on improving the public portfolio.

Harassment, discriminatory language, disclosure of private information,
misrepresentation of research, and submission of confidential or unpublished
materials are not acceptable.

Concerns may be reported privately to
[contact@bhalaji.com](mailto:contact@bhalaji.com). Reports will be reviewed by
the repository owner, who may remove content or restrict participation when
needed.
